findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Accumulated ice and frost build up was observed in the walk-in freezer below the fan unit and on the floor beneath the shelves. PIC was made aware of the ice accumulation and PIC mentioned that they had just repair the freezer and are currently in the process of getting it cleaned. Ensure that the accumulated ice is cleaned to avoid the contamination of food items and ensure safety of staff in the walk-in freezer.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: There is a leak in the right handwashing sink in the men’s restroom that was cited as a violation in the pre-opening that has not been repaired. Ensure that this leak is repaired by next routine inspection. Plumbing systems should be maintained in good repair. 

 A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following physical facilities that were cited as violations in the pre-opening are still in need of repair: 

1. The ceiling tiles over the island area/hot dog roller area need to be replaced with ceiling tiles that are smooth, cleanable, and nonabsorbent. 
2. The cabinet shelving beneath the self-service coffee area and the f’real machine has soiled and chipped paint surfaces. Clean and reseal interior of cabinets. 
3. The single ceiling tile in the women’s restroom needs replaced with one that is smooth and easily cleanable. 
4. The ceiling tiles in the men’s restroom need to be switched with tiles that are smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
5. The two holes in the left wall as you enter the room with the triple sink need repaired. 
6. The damaged 3 or 4 tiles in the walk-in cooler need repaired. 

Ensure that these physical facilities are repaired and/or cleaned by next routine inspection. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
